snippet.title: Version 2.4 Teaser - "On the Precipice of the Abyss" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
"After hearing countless voices of the dead... Why not listen to your inner voice..."
"But what if the path you're walking is just a detour, one laid out by others to lead you to their version of the truth?"

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5·iOS·Android·PC·Xbox｜Version 2.3 "Memories of Dreams Bygone" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
